name: Comedy Writing Minor
intro: Focused on the writing of comedy, students will learn to craft comedy across multiple platforms and refine their comedic voice. The curriculum is structured with three introduction courses: the study of comedy, the craft of comedic writing, and the importance of comedy in the human experience.

courses.title: Is This A Joke: Mechanics of Comedy Writing
Why The Long Face: Writing Comedy & the Human Experience
